
    <h2 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/life2refuel/p/19637727" title="发布于 2026-02-25 16:19">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C 里面如何使用链表 list</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <div class="postText"><div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>c 的世界可能高频业务都依赖 list 增删改查. 这里简单交流下自己在 c 里面使用 list&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>1. 学生时代, 那会学习 C 数据结构, 比较简单</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> person {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> id;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> name[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64+1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> person *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next;
};</span></pre>
</div>
<p>类似上面这样, 需要什么依赖 next 指针来回调整, 然后手工 print F5 去 debug 熬.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>2. 刚工作青年时代, 主要花活, 随大流</strong></p>
<p>类似</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/wangzhione/structc/blob/master/modular/test/list.h#L1-L15" rel="noopener nofollow">structc/modular/test/list.h at master · wangzhione/structc</a></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#pragma</span> once<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

#include </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">struct.h</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> list.h 似魔鬼的步伐, 单链表库
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> $LIST 需要嵌入 struct 的第一行
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> void * list = nullptr;      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">        create list
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> list_delete(list, fide); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> [可选] delete list
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> $list {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> $list *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next;
};

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> $LIST struct $list $node;</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>或者类似</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/rustyrussell/ccan/blob/master/ccan/list/list.h#L11-L44" rel="noopener nofollow">ccan/ccan/list/list.h at master · rustyrussell/ccan</a></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * struct list_node - an entry in a doubly-linked list
 * @next: next entry (self if empty)
 * @prev: previous entry (self if empty)
 *
 * This is used as an entry in a linked list.
 * Example:
 *    struct child {
 *        const char *name;
 *        // Linked list of all us children.
 *        struct list_node list;
 *    };
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list_node
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> list_node *next, *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">prev;
};

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * struct list_head - the head of a doubly-linked list
 * @h: the list_head (containing next and prev pointers)
 *
 * This is used as the head of a linked list.
 * Example:
 *    struct parent {
 *        const char *name;
 *        struct list_head children;
 *        unsigned int num_children;
 *    };
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list_head
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list_node n;
};</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>杂技, 理解的心智负担稍微高一点, 但使用上对方有了单元测试, 比较成熟, list 结构问题较少, 除了业务的内存错位自己 debug 稍微麻烦点.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>3. 35岁中年之后, 又想起刚开始那会</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/cloudwu/skynet/blob/master/skynet-src/socket_server.c#L64-L80" rel="noopener nofollow">skynet/skynet-src/socket_server.c at master · cloudwu/skynet</a></p>
<p>类似这样</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> write_buffer {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> write_buffer *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">buffer;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ptr;
    size_t sz;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userobject;
};

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> write_buffer_udp {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> write_buffer buffer;
    uint8_t udp_address[UDP_ADDRESS_SIZE];
};

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> wb_list {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> write_buffer *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> head;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> write_buffer *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tail;
};</span></pre>
</div>
<p>需要 list , 还是直接 next 指针来回调整.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>当下各种 ai 加持, 这种方式可能是最简单最直接, 当然 c 写代码相对麻烦, 多做好单元测试.</p>
<p>人生也类似, 兜兜转转一个圈, 那种圈在时空维度看, 是螺旋上升的.&nbsp;</p>
<p>不知道有没有人好奇, 为什么不直接一开始就上升呢, 可能生命不需要赶着投胎吧, 浪费不是时间, 也不是人生, 也可能是享受到了时间, 享受到了自己来回波动的人生.&nbsp;<br><br>: ) Good luckly ~<br><br><strong>4. 未来时代, 对于个人而言, C 融入自己思维一部分, 可能不再去主动写了.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>类似婴儿那会记忆, 与其说忘了, 已经存在于脑海最底层机制里面了.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
